Ellen / team,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — appreciate you walking us through the telemetry needs and the compliance constraints. Attached is the mutual action plan (MAP) draft from our session. High level summary and asks below.

Milestones (draft):
- Pilot kickoff (small workload) — target: 2027-05-10 — owner: Aurora IT (Rajiv)
- Security review & evidence (SOC2 + network checklist) — target: 2027-05-03 — owner: Aurora Security (Sue)
- Pricing & procurement LOI — target: 2027-05-12 — owner: Procurement
- Production enablement & training — target: 2027-05-20 — owner: Redwood CS (Laura)

Dependencies: SOC2 summary, network peering checklist, procurement PO window.

Please: 1) confirm owners (I used names from today where I could), 2) flag anything missing, and 3) confirm the pilot date if that works for your infra team. I attached Aurora-MAP-v1.0.xlsx for easy edits.

Attachments: Aurora-MAP-v1.0.xlsx

Next steps (from our side): we will update the MAP with your security/IT owners and circulate an updated version by Friday.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com

Thanks Rishi — good recap. A few updates from our side after a quick sync with Security and Procurement:

- Security has assigned Sue to drive the questionnaire and network review. She asked for a short SOC2 summary (control scope + date) and the network peering checklist. Can you send those? (I copied Sue here.)
- Procurement looped procurement@aurorahealth.com on pricing cadence. Our PO cycle for new vendors is ~2–3 weeks after terms sign-off.
- Rajiv confirmed pilot window is possible but needs the subnet & NAT details by end of next week (2027-04-23).

We'd like to propose a phased pilot: lightweight end-to-end on May 10, then a broader pilot the following week. If that aligns on your side, please update the MAP and include an explicit pilot acceptance criterion.

I've attached the SOC2-Summary (high level).

Thanks,
Ellen

- Owners: Sue (Security) for questionnaire; Rajiv (IT) for network; Procurement for PO; Laura (Redwood CS) for training.
- Target close date moved to 2027-05-20 to give procurement time for T&C and PO.

Also attaching our pricing term sheet you can share with procurement to speed the PO (pricing-term-sheet.pdf).

Planned next steps: I will push a second MAP update with links to the network checklist and a Drive folder by Wednesday. Can I get a confirm from Rajiv that he can deliver the subnet/NAT details by 2027-04-23?
